# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Docs first (required)

**ALL code generated by Claude Code MUST ALWAYS first refer to the relevant docs file in the `/docs` directory, before any code is written.** This applies to every code generation task, no matter how small. Check `/docs` for the file covering the area you are working on (e.g. `docs/ui.md` for UI work) and follow its guidance. Do not write code until you have read the relevant doc(s).

Available docs:
- /docs/ui.md
- /docs/data-fetching.md

## Commands

- `npm run dev` — start dev server (http://localhost:3000)
- `npm run build` / `npm run start` — production build / serve
- `npm run lint` — ESLint (flat config in `eslint.config.mjs`)
- No test runner is configured.

## Stack and conventions

- Next.js 16.4.2 (App Router) with React 19.3, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 (via `@tailwindcss/turbopack`).
- **This Next.js version has breaking changes from what you may know.** Per `AGENTS.md`, read the relevant guide in `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` (organized as `01-app`, `02-pages`, `03-architecture`, `04-community`) before writing Next.js code, and heed deprecation notices.
- App code lives in `src/app/` (`layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, `globals.css`). Path alias `@/*` maps to `./src/*`.
- Project is an early scaffold from Create Next App (a lifting diary app); no custom architecture yet.
